latent_definition.primary: posterior class probabilities p(z|x) of the 32x64 categorical latent (softmax of obslogit with unimix 0.01), from one observe step from the initial carry; deterministic
latent_definition.excluded: deterministic state h (constant across inputs for a single observe step from the initial carry; verified by deter_std_max)

channels.kappa: kappa_pair = q90/q10 of ||p_i-p_j||_2 / ||x_i-x_j||_2 over 20000 random frame pairs (seed 0)
channels.tc: tc_between = 0.5*(sum_g logdet S_gg - logdet S), probabilities, one class dropped per group, ridge 1e-3 (1e-4 and 1e-2 reported as sensitivity)
channels.lee: lee_v2 = mean over {rotation +-5 deg, translation +-1 px, scale 1+-0.05} of E||p(T+x) - p(T-x)||_2 / generator step
channels.rhs: kappa_n + tc_n + lee_n with unit weights after natural-zero scaling

secondary.kappa_sem: q90/q10 of ||p_i-p_j|| / d_sem(i,j) over the same 20000 pairs; d_sem = |pos|_1/10 + |inv|_1/5 + fraction of differing cells in the 9x7 local semantic window (weights fixed here)
secondary.kappa_pix_vs_sem: Spearman rho of kappa_pair vs kappa_sem across all audited checkpoints, run-bootstrap CI
secondary.lee_fit: residual of a ridge (1e-2) linear map on the top-128 PCA coordinates of p, fitted on half the frames, evaluated on the other half (seed 0)
secondary.alias_sem: fraction of 10 latent nearest neighbours with a different semantic id
secondary.lee_intervention: mean lee_v2 (aug) / mean lee_v2 (aug_base) - 1 over steps >= 250k, per seed, with bootstrap CI over seeds

scaling.method: per channel: (v - z_c) / median_cal(v - z_c), natural zero z_c = 1 for kappa (ratio >= 1), 0 for TC, LEE and baselines; medians from the calibration set only
scaling._why_not_minmax: min-max (the paper's choice) maps the healthiest calibration checkpoint to RHS = 0; with J* taken over all runs its gap is positive, so beta* becomes infinite. Min-max is reported only as a sensitivity analysis (--minmax_sensitivity).
scaling._why_no_upper_clip: clipping at 1 would hide large defect values on test runs and make the test unable to fail

return.statistic: mean of all episodes ending within +-window of the checkpoint step; n and SEM reported
return.J_star: max J over ALL runs and checkpoints in the analysis set
return._note_J_star: J* uses returns of test runs by design (2q75 asked for regret to the best observed run); the rule is fixed here, not tuned

calibration.run: TODO name of the paper's main run

test_sets.T1_same_run_late: all checkpoints of the main run with step > 500000 (report every one, not only 3.5M)
test_sets.T2_cross_run: all checkpoints of the 6 augmentation-experiment runs (3 baseline + 3 aug seeds)
test_sets.T3_tc_sweep: all checkpoints of the TC-sweep runs IF their logdirs exist; otherwise reported as unavailable
test_sets.T4_latent_mask: late main-run checkpoint with k in {0,4,8,16,24} categorical groups clamped at inference (optional)

failure_labels.step_matched: J below (mean - 2 SD) of healthy baseline seeds at the same step; SD across >= 3 baseline seeds

metrics.coverage: fraction with beta*RHS >= gap_norm, per run and per test set
metrics.tightness: median and IQR of beta*RHS/gap_norm for gap_norm > 0.05
metrics.auroc_direction: higher RHS => failure (never flipped after seeing data)
auroc_variants: step-stratified (pairs compared only within the same step)
metrics.conformal: split-conformal over seeds of the SAME configuration (aug_base runs, calibration run excluded): score_r = max_t gap/RHS; beta_alpha = ceil((n+1)(1-alpha))-th smallest score; valid only for alpha >= 1/(n+1); says nothing about other configurations or failing runs
metrics.ablation: remove one channel, REFIT beta* on the calibration set, then test (fixed-beta ablation is not reported)

lead_lag.t_drop: first step where J < baseline mean - 1 SD for 3 consecutive checkpoints
lead_lag.t_alarm: first step where channel deviates > 2 SD from baseline mean (either direction; direction recorded)
lead_lag.false_alarm_rate: same rule applied to each held-out healthy baseline seed against the remaining seeds
lead_lag.note: a TC alarm in a TC-penalty run is caused by the penalty itself and is not counted as diagnostic evidence
